questions.q: My friend Ahmet ____ play the guitar very well.
questions.why: Can modal fiili her özne ile aynı kalır ve yalın fiil alır.

questions.q: I ____ speak English, but I can't speak French.
questions.why: Olumlu beceri ifadesi için 'can' kullanılır.

questions.q: She ____ drive a car because she doesn't have a license.
questions.why: Yapılamayan eylemler için 'can't' kullanılır.

questions.q: ____ you help me with my homework, please?
questions.why: Rica cümlelerinde cümlenin başında 'Can' kullanılır.

questions.q: He can ____ fast, but he can't swim.
questions.why: Can modal fiilinden sonra gelen fiil yalın hâlde olmalıdır.

questions.q: We ____ come to your party tonight; we are very busy.
questions.why: Geleceğe yönelik yetersizlik veya imkânsızlık 'can't' ile belirtilir.

questions.q: Which sentence is correct?
o: She can to swim very fast.
She is can swim very fast.
questions.why: 'Can' sonrasındaki fiil ek almaz ve 'to' ile kullanılmaz.

questions.q: Can your best friend speak German?
questions.why: Can ile sorulan sorulara kısa olumlu cevap 'Yes, [özne] can' şeklinde verilir.

questions.q: They ____ play football, but they can play basketball.
questions.why: Cümlenin devamındaki tezatlık 'can't' gerektirir.

questions.q: Can I ____ the window? It is very hot inside.
questions.why: Can kalıbından sonra fiil yalın kullanılır.

reading.title: My Talented Friends
reading.text: I have two very good friends, Murat and Elif. We spend a lot of time together. Murat is very artistic. He can play the guitar and he can paint beautiful pictures. However, he can't swim at all. Elif is very energetic and sporty. She can run very fast and she can swim like a fish. But she can't play any musical instruments. I am different from them. I can cook amazing Turkish food for us. We can always help each other when we need something.

questions.q: What can Murat do?
questions.why: Murat'ın gitar çalıp resim yapabildiği metinde açıkça belirtilmiştir.

questions.q: What is something Murat cannot do?
questions.why: Murat'ın hiç yüzemediği ifade edilmiştir.

questions.q: How is Elif described?
questions.why: Elif enerjik ve sportif olarak tanımlanmıştır.

questions.q: What can Elif do very well?
questions.why: Elif çok hızlı koşabilir ve iyi yüzebilir.

questions.q: What can't Elif do?
questions.why: Elif müzik aleti çalamaz.

questions.q: What is the writer's skill?
questions.why: Yazar lezzetli Türk yemekleri pişirebildiğini söyler.

questions.q: What can the friends do together?
questions.why: İhtiyaç duyduklarında birbirlerine her zaman yardım edebilirler.

questions.q: What did Anna get?
questions.why: Anna sürücü ehliyetini almıştır.

questions.q: Did Anna pass her driving test the first time?
questions.why: İlk denemesinde geçemediğini açıkça söyler.

questions.q: Why does Anna talk to herself when driving?

questions.q: Why was the instructor John afraid during the test?

questions.q: Why were people honking at them?
questions.why: Çok yavaş sürdüğü için arkadakiler korna çalmıştır.

questions.q: What can't you do at the White House according to Marsha?
questions.why: Beyaz Saray'a arabayla yanaşılamayacağını söyler.

writing.prompt: En yakın arkadaşınızı ve onun yeteneklerini anlatan kısa bir yazı yazın. Neleri yapabilir, neleri yapamaz? 'can' ve 'can't' yapılarını kullanın.
writing.prompt_en: Write a short text about your best friend and their talents. What can they do, and what can't they do? Use 'can' and 'can't'.
writing.model: My best friend is Caner. He is thirty years old. He is very smart and talented. He can speak English and German fluently. He can also play basketball very well. But he can't swim and he can't cook. I like spending time with him.

read: My best friend can play the piano very well.
I can drive a car, but I can't ride a motorcycle.
Can you help me with this heavy box?

ask.q: What can your best friend do, and what can't they do?
ask.tr: En yakın arkadaşınız ne yapabilir ve ne yapamaz? En az iki cümleyle anlatın.
